meta.name: game-build
meta.description: Build the game for its approved target runtime. Compress GAME_DESIGN and ART_DIRECTION into a minimal BUILD_BRIEF, hand it to the current coding agent or another strong model to implement a fully playable build, and iterate against real runs and captured evidence. Use for implement the approved game design, build the game prototype, turn this design into a running game. 游戏构建执行。把批准后的 GAME_DESIGN 与 ART_DIRECTION 压缩成最小 BUILD_BRIEF，交给当前编码智能体或其他强模型，在选定的目标运行环境中实现可完整游玩的版本，并通过真实运行和证据迭代。用于把批准的游戏方案实现成可运行游戏。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成批准游戏设计的可运行版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有批准的游戏设计,想快速得到可游玩的原型。
copy.tagline_en: Generate a playable build from your approved game design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an approved game design and want a playable build quickly.

howto.what: 把批准的游戏设计与美术方向压成最小构建说明，交给编码模型在指定运行环境实现可完整游玩的游戏，再用真实运行和证据反复修改，最后产出游戏本体、构建说明和质量验证记录。
howto.when: 当你说“把设计做成可运行游戏”“实现已批准方案”“构建原型”，且已有 GAME_DESIGN.md 与 ART_DIRECTION.md 时触发。

say.text: 按批准的设计先做一个简易版，验证核心规则和范围。
say.note: 规则通过后再做画面打磨和完整验证。

say.text: 构建完成后运行权威验证命令，把证据存到工作区。

howto.what_en: Compresses approved design + art direction into a minimal BUILD_BRIEF, hands it to a coding model to make a playable build for the target runtime, then iterates on real runs and evidence. Outputs the game, BUILD_BRIEF.md, and qa/verification.json.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to implement an approved game design, build the game prototype, or turn the design into a running game, and GAME_DESIGN.md plus ART_DIRECTION.md already exist.

say_en.text: Turn GAME_DESIGN.md and ART_DIRECTION.md into a playable game.
say_en.note: It writes BUILD_BRIEF first, then starts building.

say_en.text: Make a simple playable version from the approved design to check the core rules.
say_en.note: After that it moves to visuals and full verification.

say_en.text: Run the authoritative verification command and save evidence in the workspace.
